description_long: The Body & Soul Homeless Program is an ecumenical, community, and faith-based program. We partner with public and private sectors to inspire persons experiencing homelessness to lead hopeful and productive lives. We serve out of the basement of St. Paul United Methodist Church , 27 years and counting. We are the beckon light in the arts district, assisting those that desire to get off the streets. Visit our website to learn more about our weekend volunteer opportunities in the Downtown Dallas – Arts District.

description_long: Hi Servant Hearts!! My name is Inga Wilson – team lead for Tango Charities “Feed The City” in Irving, TX. Please join me as we Feed The City at Whiskey Cake in Irving, TX to make lunches for people in need. Feed The City events are family-friendly and are open to all. We welcome organizations, groups, and school age children (high school students will receive 3 hours of credit – please bring your schools volunteer form with you). PRIOR TO THE EVENT: Head over to the store and pick up the product. Remember, the more product that is brought...The more meals we will make. WHAT TO BRING: Each person attending brings a loaf of bread, pkg of turkey or ham, cheese, mustard, a bag of cuties oranges, a large bag of chips and a box of Ziploc sandwich bags. WHAT TO WEAR: The color orange represents “Hunger Awareness,” and we always love to see that color at our events. Please wear closed-toed shoes. Date: Fourth Saturday of Each Month (8:00am-10:00am) Location: Whiskey Cake 3225 Regent Blvd Irving, TX 75063 https://www.eventbrite.com/e/feed-the-city-irving-tickets-640917109327

description_long: We are excited to open a new branch of the Hugs Training Academy in Dallas on January 3rd! Hugs Cafe, Inc. opened a Training Academy in 2022 to take our vocational training beyond those we currently employ at the cafe and greenhouse. The Hugs Training Academy curriculum is focused on providing entry level skills to students so they are ready to enter the workforce in the culinary or hospitably fields. We are looking for volunteers on Tuesdays and Thursdays at our new site at Dallas College. Times are 10am-3pm and classes begin January 3rd. The address is: Dallas College Culinary, Pastry and Hospitality Center 11830 Webb Chapel Rd #1200 Dallas, TX 75234 There will be a short training in December available via zoom or on site at Dallas College. A background check and food handlers’ certificate will be required for volunteers.
